correctItems.text: His father, a prominent physician, deliberated with his wife whether the time had come to kill the entire family, or if he should commit suicide alone.
Helmuth remembers that he saw his father's bloody uniform being burnt in the family fireplace.
So traumatised was he by what he had overheard and what had happened, that he reacted by refusing to eat at home for the following nine years!
Although Helmuth may not have realised all that it meant, his father had been a Nazi and a supporter of Adolf Hitler.
